newsitem.title: UK: Countryside Props splits chairman/ceo role.
newsitem.headline: Countryside Props splits chairman/ceo role.

text.p: Countryside Properties Plc said on Tuesday it was splitting the combined position of chairman and chief executive from today, with Alan Cherry remaining chairman and Graham Cherry becoming chief executive.

Graham Cherry, the son of Alan Cherry, was a former joint managing director along with his brother Richard Cherry. Richard is also getting main board responsibility for all new business development throughout the group, the group said in a statement.

As part of management changes expected to help the company achieve sustained growth, Countryside Properties said David Thornham, a former non-executive director, had been appointed deputy charman to succeed Michael Pearce.
Pearce could therefore concentrate his full attention on his role as finance director, the company added.
